articles.title: India’s Bellatrix raises $20 million following overseas expansion drive
articles.summary:
India-based Bellatrix Aerospace announced March 27 it has raised $20 million to ramp up production of its satellite propulsion systems after securing its first large commercial customer outside the country.
The post India’s Bellatrix raises $20 million following overseas expansion drive appeared first on SpaceNews.

articles.title: Live coverage: Artemis 2 astronauts head to Florida ahead of April 1 launch attempt
articles.summary: The crew is expected to land in Florida around 2:30 p.m. EDT (1830 UTC) on Friday. April 1 at 6:24 p.m. EDT (2224 UTC) is the earliest launch opportunity during a six-day window.
